strings.zh: 前面就是滚烫的岩浆,{NEWLINE}还是不要靠近的好。
strings.en: The lava’s right up ahead. Better not{NEWLINE}get too close.

strings.zh: 小爱『伯伯,伯伯,{NEWLINE}快点出下一道题吧！
strings.en: Amber: Uncle, Uncle! Hurry up and give{NEWLINE}me the next riddle!

strings.zh: 哈哈,好的小爱,{NEWLINE}那我可要出题了哦。
strings.en: Ha ha, all right, Amber. Here comes the{NEWLINE}riddle!
strings.notes: Speaker is Blaine (the restaurant ‘uncle’, 伯伯); the zh gives him no label in this scene, so none is added.

strings.zh: 小爱『来吧！{NEWLINE}这次我一定能够答上来！
strings.en: Amber: Bring it on! This time I’ll get it{NEWLINE}for sure!

strings.zh: 那么,脑袋冰冰{NEWLINE}身体暖暖的是什么东西呢？
strings.en: Now then: what has a cold head and a{NEWLINE}warm body?

strings.zh: 小爱『唔……{NEWLINE}把脑袋放到冰箱里,{CLEAR}身上裹上电热……
strings.en: Amber: Hmm... put your head in the{NEWLINE}fridge, and wrap your body in an{CLEAR}electric blanket...

strings.zh: 小爱『我知道啦！露天温泉嘛！
strings.en: Amber: I know! An outdoor hot spring!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈,没错,就是露天温泉。{NEWLINE}一开始我还以为你又要{CLEAR}说出什么奇奇怪怪的答案呢。
strings.en: Hah hah hah, that’s right! An outdoor{NEWLINE}hot spring.{SCROLL}At first I thought you’d give me{NEWLINE}another one of your weird answers.

strings.zh: 小爱『这个我知道！就是透明人嘛！
strings.en: Amber: I know this one! An invisible{NEWLINE}man!

strings.zh: 不对不对。
strings.en: Nope, nope.

strings.zh: 小爱『那是空气吗？
strings.en: Amber: Then is it air?

strings.zh: 也不对。
strings.en: Not that either.

strings.zh: 小爱『那是什么嘛！
strings.en: Amber: Then what is it?!

strings.zh: 答案是眼皮哦。
strings.en: The answer is your eyelids!

strings.zh: 小爱『对哦！确实是眼皮呢！
strings.en: Amber: Oh yeah! It really is your{NEWLINE}eyelids!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,怎么样,{NEWLINE}我今天想的谜题很有意思吧。
strings.en: Heh heh, well? Weren’t my riddles fun{NEWLINE}today?

strings.zh: 小爱『嗯,很有意思呢。{NEWLINE}不过伯伯,小爱今天也想了一个谜题,{CLEAR}你也来猜一猜我的谜题吧！
strings.en: Amber: Mm-hmm, they were really fun.{SCROLL}But Uncle, Amber thought up a riddle{NEWLINE}today too! Now you try to guess mine!
strings.notes: Amber refers to herself in the third person (小爱) as in the zh.

strings.zh: 哦？小爱也能想出谜题了？{NEWLINE}快说来我猜一猜。
strings.en: Oh? Amber can make up riddles now too?{NEWLINE}Go on, let me guess.

strings.zh: 小爱『哥哥弟弟追赶跑跳碰,是什么呢？
strings.en: Amber: Big brother, little brother,{NEWLINE}chasing, running, jumping, bumping.{SCROLL}What is it?

strings.zh: 喔,这个很有难度哦。{NEWLINE}不过可难不倒我,{CLEAR}答案应该是时钟！对不对？
strings.en: Ooh, that’s a tough one. But it won’t{NEWLINE}stump me!{SCROLL}The answer must be... a clock! Am I{NEWLINE}right?

strings.zh: 德特里克私人实验室{NEWLINE}闲杂人等严禁入内！
strings.en: Detrick Private Laboratory{NEWLINE}Authorized personnel only!
strings.notes: 德特里克 → ‘Detrick’ (romanised; no official source found).

strings.zh: 这里是度假胜地红莲岛{NEWLINE}忘记旅途的疲劳,尽情休息吧！
strings.en: Welcome to Cinnabar Island,{NEWLINE}the resort getaway!{SCROLL}Forget the weariness of your{NEWLINE}travels and relax to your{CLEAR}heart’s content!

strings.zh: 小爱『BuBu——,不对哦！
strings.en: Amber: Bzzzt! Wrong!

strings.zh: 啊？不是时钟吗？{NEWLINE}分针和时针互相追赶并相遇,{CLEAR}不就是哥哥弟弟追赶跑跳碰吗？
strings.en: Huh? It’s not a clock?{SCROLL}The minute hand and the hour hand{NEWLINE}chase each other and meet...{SCROLL}Isn’t that big brother and little{NEWLINE}brother chasing and bumping?

strings.zh: 小爱『虽然伯伯这么说也没错啦,{NEWLINE}不过小爱想的答案是：{CLEAR}兄弟姐妹一起玩耍！{SCROLL}小爱『小爱出生在红莲岛,{NEWLINE}因为身体不好,从来都没离开过这里。{CLEAR}爸爸每天忙着工作也没时间陪我玩,{CLEAR}就只有伯伯能来陪我玩猜谜游戏。{CLEAR}所以小爱心里还是挺孤单的。{SCROLL}小爱『不过最近这段时间啊,{NEWLINE}我每天晚上都能梦到{CLEAR}一只猫咪样子的口袋妖怪陪我一起玩。{CLEAR}我们一起追逐打闹,可开心了！
strings.en: Amber: You’re not wrong, Uncle, but the{NEWLINE}answer Amber was thinking of is...{CLEAR}brothers and sisters playing together!{SCROLL}Amber: Amber was born on Cinnabar{NEWLINE}Island, and because I’m sick, I’ve{CLEAR}never left here.{SCROLL}Daddy’s always busy with work and has{NEWLINE}no time to play with me.{SCROLL}Only you come and play riddle games with{NEWLINE}me, Uncle. So Amber’s pretty lonely.{SCROLL}Amber: But lately, every night, I dream{NEWLINE}about a Pokémon that looks like a kitty,{CLEAR}and it plays with me.{SCROLL}We chase each other around. It’s so{NEWLINE}much fun!

strings.zh: 小爱……
strings.en: Amber...

strings.zh: 小爱『虽然小爱是人,{NEWLINE}那只猫咪是口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}可是我感觉我们就像是{CLEAR}一个母亲怀抱里走出来的{CLEAR}兄弟姐妹一样呢。{SCROLL}小爱『所以我今天的谜题{NEWLINE}哥哥弟弟追赶跑跳碰{CLEAR}就是指的兄弟姐妹一起玩耍哦！
strings.en: Amber: Amber’s a person, and the{NEWLINE}kitty’s a Pokémon, but it feels like{CLEAR}we’re brother and sister, from the same{CLEAR}mother’s arms.{SCROLL}Amber: So today’s riddle, big brother{NEWLINE}and little brother chasing, running,{CLEAR}jumping, bumping, means brothers and{CLEAR}sisters playing together!

strings.zh: 真是很棒的谜题和答案呢！{NEWLINE}作为你想出这么棒的谜题的奖励,{CLEAR}这个送给你吧！
strings.en: What a wonderful riddle and answer!{SCROLL}As a reward for thinking up such a{NEWLINE}great riddle, this is for you!

strings.zh: 小爱『这个是……画册里说的那个{NEWLINE}能呼唤洁咪的冰空花束！？
strings.en: Amber: This is... the Gracidea from my{NEWLINE}picture book!{SCROLL}The one that can call Shaymin!?

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,没错。这就是小爱你以前{NEWLINE}跟我说过的那个冰空花束。{CLEAR}其实我本来想去桐树林{CLEAR}找到洁咪带回来帮你治病的,{CLEAR}但很遗憾没能找到洁咪,{CLEAR}只找到了这个冰空花束。
strings.en: Heh heh, that’s right. This is the{NEWLINE}Gracidea you told me about, Amber.{SCROLL}Actually, I went to Ilex Forest hoping{NEWLINE}to find Shaymin and bring it back to{CLEAR}cure your illness.{SCROLL}Sadly, I couldn’t find Shaymin. All I{NEWLINE}found was this Gracidea.

strings.zh: 小爱『呜……谢谢你伯伯！{NEWLINE}你对我真是太好了,{CLEAR}我有这个冰空花束就足够了！
strings.en: Amber: *sniff*... Thank you, Uncle!{SCROLL}You’re so good to me. Having this{NEWLINE}Gracidea is enough for me!

strings.zh: 这个冰空花束也有净化环境的功效,{NEWLINE}把它放到你的房间里,{CLEAR}或许对病情也有帮助哦。
strings.en: Gracidea also purify the air around{NEWLINE}them.{SCROLL}Put it in your room, and maybe it’ll help{NEWLINE}with your illness.

strings.zh: 小爱『呜呜……嗯……好的伯伯,{NEWLINE}谢谢你！
strings.en: Amber: *sniff*... Mm... OK, Uncle. Thank{NEWLINE}you!

strings.zh: 小爱啊,{NEWLINE}伯伯现在要回餐馆照顾生意了,{CLEAR}你玩够了也早点回实验室吧。
strings.en: Amber, I have to get back and look{NEWLINE}after the restaurant now.{SCROLL}When you’re done playing, head back to{NEWLINE}the lab early, OK?

strings.zh: 小爱『嗯,好！{NEWLINE}明天再出来一起玩啊！
strings.en: Amber: Mm, OK! Let’s play again{NEWLINE}tomorrow!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,没问题,不见不散！
strings.en: Heh heh, you bet. It’s a date!

strings.zh: 你是……来岛上的游客吗？{NEWLINE}是来找我回餐馆的？{CLEAR}确实……今天已经出来挺久了。
strings.en: Are you... a tourist visiting the island?{SCROLL}Did you come looking for me to take me{NEWLINE}back to the restaurant?{SCROLL}Well... I have been out a good while{NEWLINE}today.
strings.notes: Speaker unclear (probably Blaine, the restaurant owner, when the player approaches during the riddle scene); translated literally.

strings.zh: 每天出来呼吸新鲜空气的时候,{NEWLINE}餐厅的伯伯都会来陪我玩猜谜游戏哦。{CLEAR}等哪天小爱的病好了,{CLEAR}就可以跟伯伯玩一整天的猜谜游戏了。
strings.en: Every day when I come out for fresh{NEWLINE}air, the uncle from the restaurant{CLEAR}plays riddle games with me.{SCROLL}Once Amber’s better, I can play riddles{NEWLINE}with Uncle all day long.

strings.zh: 嘻嘻,我正在跟伯伯玩猜迷游戏,{NEWLINE}伯伯每次都能想出好玩的谜题呢。
strings.en: Tee-hee, I’m playing a riddle game with{NEWLINE}Uncle.{SCROLL}He always thinks up such fun riddles.

strings.zh: 乱讲,哪有奇奇怪怪嘛。
strings.en: You’re making that up! My answers{NEWLINE}aren’t weird!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈,好。{NEWLINE}再听听我的这道题,{CLEAR}看你能说出什么样的答案。{CLEAR}近在眼前却看不到的东西是什么呢？
strings.en: Hah hah hah, all right.{SCROLL}Listen to this one, and let’s see what{NEWLINE}answer you come up with.{SCROLL}What’s right in front of your eyes, but{NEWLINE}you can’t see it?

strings.zh: 这里是私人实验室,{NEWLINE}不接待一般游客。{CLEAR}你到别处去观光吧！
strings.en: This is a private laboratory.{SCROLL}We don’t receive ordinary tourists. Go{NEWLINE}sightseeing somewhere else!

strings.zh: 干什么！{NEWLINE}这里是私人实验室,{CLEAR}要观光去别的地方！
strings.en: What do you want?! This is a private{NEWLINE}laboratory.{SCROLL}Go sightseeing somewhere else!

strings.zh: 大……大事不好了！{NEWLINE}实验室里那个怪物暴走了！
strings.en: Th-this is bad! The monster in the lab{NEWLINE}has gone berserk!

strings.zh: 什么？什么事？
strings.en: What? What’s going on?

strings.zh: 总之就是出大事了！{NEWLINE}富士博士已经启动了紧急锁闭系统,{CLEAR}要尽可能地把那个怪物困在实验室里。{CLEAR}你快护送我去找老大报告情况！
strings.en: Something terrible’s happened, that’s{NEWLINE}what!{SCROLL}Dr. Fuji has activated the emergency{NEWLINE}lockdown to keep that monster trapped{CLEAR}in the lab as long as he can.{SCROLL}Quick, escort me to report to the Boss!

strings.zh: 我跟餐馆的伯伯{NEWLINE}约了在这里玩猜谜游戏,{CLEAR}他应该快来了吧。
strings.en: I promised the restaurant uncle I’d{NEWLINE}meet him here for riddles.{SCROLL}He should be here soon.

strings.zh: 传说中火焰鸟是红莲岛的守护圣鸟,{NEWLINE}当红莲岛的人们和精灵{CLEAR}受到来自火山的威胁时,{CLEAR}火焰鸟就会现身,{CLEAR}用它那神圣的火焰保护这里的生命。
strings.en: Legend says Moltres is the sacred{NEWLINE}guardian bird of Cinnabar Island.{SCROLL}When the people and Pokémon of Cinnabar{NEWLINE}are threatened by the volcano, Moltres{CLEAR}appears and protects the lives here{CLEAR}with its sacred flames.

strings.zh: 哦,亲爱的,火焰和海洋{NEWLINE}在红莲岛这里交织,{CLEAR}仿佛就是世界的尽头。{CLEAR}能跟你一起欣赏这美景真是太好了。
strings.en: Oh, darling, fire and sea meet here on{NEWLINE}Cinnabar Island.{SCROLL}It’s like the end of the world. I’m so{NEWLINE}glad I get to enjoy this view with you.

strings.zh: 你如果也有道具探测器的话,{NEWLINE}就能在看似没有东西的地面上{CLEAR}找到道具了。{SCROLL}什么？{NEWLINE}想让我吧道具探测器送给你？{CLEAR}那可不行！{CLEAR}你如果想要道具探测器的话,{CLEAR}去找尼比市那边的研究员问问吧。{SCROLL}干他们那一行的{NEWLINE}应该会有很多这种东西。
strings.en: With a Dowsing Machine, you can find{NEWLINE}items where there seem to be none.{SCROLL}What? You want me to give you my{NEWLINE}Dowsing Machine? No way!{SCROLL}If you want a Dowsing Machine, go ask{NEWLINE}the researcher over in Pewter City.{SCROLL}People in that line of work must have{NEWLINE}loads of those things.

strings.zh: 你不是也有道具探测器吗？{NEWLINE}用那个就能在看似没有东西的地面上{CLEAR}找到道具了。
strings.en: Don’t you have a Dowsing Machine too?{SCROLL}Use it and you can find items on ground{NEWLINE}that looks empty.

strings.zh: 我也这么觉得呢亲爱的,{NEWLINE}选这里来度假真是太好了！
strings.en: I think so too, darling. Coming here for{NEWLINE}our vacation was the best idea!

strings.zh: 我觉得在这样美丽的地方,{NEWLINE}非常适合……
strings.en: In a beautiful place like this, I think{NEWLINE}it’s perfect for...

strings.zh: 唔……羞死了,你说什么呢！
strings.en: Ooh... How embarrassing! What are you{NEWLINE}saying?!

strings.zh: 我说非常适合吃一顿海鲜大餐啊,{NEWLINE}怎么了吗？
strings.en: I said it’s perfect for a big seafood{NEWLINE}feast. Why, what’s wrong?

strings.zh: 啊啊……哈哈,没什么……{NEWLINE}我以为……你笑话我饭量大呢！
strings.en: Ah... ha ha, nothing... I thought... you{NEWLINE}were teasing me for eating so much!

strings.zh: 哎呀,怎么会呢！{NEWLINE}在我心中你就是最美的。
strings.en: Oh, come on, how could I? To me, you’re{NEWLINE}the most beautiful girl in the world.

strings.zh: 看什么看啊,没见过情侣秀恩爱吗。
strings.en: What are you staring at? Never seen a{NEWLINE}couple being lovey-dovey before?

strings.zh: 你在我心中也是最帅的呢。
strings.en: And to me, you’re the most handsome{NEWLINE}guy in the world.

strings.zh: 红莲岛的石头质地真不错,{NEWLINE}咱们在上面刻几个字吧？
strings.en: The rock on Cinnabar Island is really{NEWLINE}nice. Shall we carve a few words into it?

strings.zh: 好啊,就写咱们两个{NEWLINE}到此一游怎么样？
strings.en: Sure! How about ‘We were here,’ with{NEWLINE}both our names?

strings.zh: 这个好,就这么办！
strings.en: Good idea! Let’s do it!

strings.zh: 要去阻止他们在景点乱写乱画吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Stop them from scribbling all over the{NEWLINE}scenic spot?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 嘿呀——！
strings.en: Hi-yah!

strings.zh: 哦呼——！
strings.en: Oh-hoo!

strings.zh: 哈哈,成啦！
strings.en: Ha ha, done!

strings.zh: 这样一来咱们的大名{NEWLINE}就会永远流传下去啦！
strings.en: Now our names will live on forever!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不要在景点写写画画,{NEWLINE}这样是不对的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t scribble on scenic{NEWLINE}spots. It’s wrong!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『喂喂喂！你们两个干什么呢！{NEWLINE}这里是你们涂鸦的地方吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Hey, hey, hey! What are you{NEWLINE}two doing?! Is this a place for graffiti?

strings.zh: 你是谁？学校的老师吗？{NEWLINE}用你管这么多！
strings.en: Who are you? A schoolteacher? Mind{NEWLINE}your own business!

strings.zh: 就是嘛！不要多管闲事！
strings.en: Yeah! Quit butting in!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『做这种事太没有公德了,{NEWLINE}我不能眼看着你们污损景点。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Doing something like this shows{NEWLINE}zero public decency.{SCROLL}I can’t just stand by and watch you{NEWLINE}deface a scenic spot.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们干的这点缺德事{NEWLINE}我今天还就管定了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You two and your rotten little{NEWLINE}stunt... I’m putting a stop to it today!

strings.zh: 哼,那你就拿出实力来{NEWLINE}让我们看看你够不够资格{CLEAR}向我们说教吧！
strings.en: Hmph.{SCROLL}Then show us what you’ve got, and we’ll{NEWLINE}see if you’ve earned the right to{CLEAR}lecture us!

strings.zh: 好强啊……你这么厉害{NEWLINE}去我们学校一定是孩子王。
strings.en: So strong... With skills like that, you’d{NEWLINE}be king of the kids at our school.

strings.zh: 我们保证以后都会爱护公共环境,{NEWLINE}不再乱涂乱画了。
strings.en: We promise to take care of public places{NEWLINE}from now on. No more graffiti.

strings.zh: 哈哈,景区的石头上{NEWLINE}深深地刻着我们的名字,{CLEAR}真是太帅啦。
strings.en: Ha ha, our names are carved deep into{NEWLINE}the rock at the scenic spot. So cool.

strings.zh: 以火山为背景来一场痛快的较量,{NEWLINE}这就是训练家的浪漫！{CLEAR}遗憾的是我来到红莲岛后{CLEAR}并没有找到传说中那座{CLEAR}被熔岩环绕的红莲道馆。{SCROLL}我看干脆你在这里陪我打一场吧？{SCROLL}
strings.en: An all-out battle with a volcano as the{NEWLINE}backdrop...{SCROLL}That’s the romance of being a Trainer!{SCROLL}Sadly, since coming to Cinnabar Island,{NEWLINE}I haven’t found the legendary Cinnabar{CLEAR}Gym surrounded by lava.{SCROLL}How about you battle me right here{NEWLINE}instead?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不愿意接受我的挑战吗……{NEWLINE}真是太遗憾了。
strings.en: You won’t accept my challenge... What a{NEWLINE}shame.

strings.zh: 哈哈哈哈！让你看看我的激情！
strings.en: Hah hah hah hah! Let me show you my{NEWLINE}passion!

strings.zh: 你居然能战胜全力以赴的我,{NEWLINE}真是太厉害了！{CLEAR}作为陪我战斗的谢礼,请收下这个吧！
strings.en: You beat me even when I gave it{NEWLINE}everything?{SCROLL}Incredible! As thanks for battling me,{NEWLINE}please take this!

strings.zh: 红莲道馆应该不会凭空消失,{NEWLINE}一定是伪装成了什么别的建筑吧？
strings.en: The Cinnabar Gym can’t have just{NEWLINE}vanished into thin air.{SCROLL}It must be disguised as some other{NEWLINE}building, right?

strings.zh: 我们服了你了,{NEWLINE}以后不会再在石壁上刻字了。
strings.en: You win. We won’t carve anything into{NEWLINE}the rock again.

strings.zh: 哦哦哦！是你啊！{NEWLINE}多谢你在圣安努号上击败火箭队,{CLEAR}救下了我们这一船的人。{CLEAR}我才有机会来到红莲岛{CLEAR}描画这壮丽的火山。{SCROLL}这是我的一点心意,请你收下吧！
strings.en: Oh oh oh! It’s you!{SCROLL}Thank you for beating Team Rocket on{NEWLINE}the S.S. Anne and saving us all.{SCROLL}Thanks to you, I got to come to{NEWLINE}Cinnabar Island and paint this{CLEAR}magnificent volcano.{SCROLL}This is a small token of my thanks.{NEWLINE}Please accept it!

strings.zh: 能够欣赏这世界的美景,{NEWLINE}真是太好了。
strings.en: Getting to enjoy the beautiful sights of{NEWLINE}this world is truly wonderful.

strings.zh: 图图犬『Smeee——gle！
strings.en: Smeargle: Smeee-gle!

strings.zh: 我把我捡的石头{NEWLINE}拿给旁边这栋房子里的研究员,{CLEAR}他居然就给我变出了一只头盖龙来！{SCROLL}真是太不可思议了！
strings.en: I took a rock I found to the{NEWLINE}researcher in the house next door, and{CLEAR}he turned it into a Cranidos!{SCROLL}It’s just unbelievable!

strings.zh: 头盖龙『Graaa——ni！
strings.en: Cranidos: Graaa-ni!

strings.zh: 这家店明明是景区的餐厅,{NEWLINE}却不接待外地游客,{CLEAR}真的很奇怪,{CLEAR}我要好好看看这里面{CLEAR}到底有什么猫腻。
strings.en: This is supposed to be the resort’s{NEWLINE}restaurant, but it won’t serve{CLEAR}out-of-town visitors.{SCROLL}That’s really fishy. I’m going to take a{NEWLINE}good look at what’s going on in there.
